display.name: PSV EMA 50/200 Trend
display.description:
a profit-share version of the ema trend vault. we quote both sides of eth and the 50/200 ema cross on 15m decides which way we lean. one position at a time, flipped on the cross.

unlike a fixed-income vault there is no promised interest — depositors buy SHARES and their value floats with the manager's pnl. the manager takes a 15% carry on realized profit and a 2%/yr management fee; when the strategy makes money the share price rises and everyone shares it, when it loses the share price falls.

buy cheaper, get more shares. a 2%/yr management fee drips to the manager continuously regardless of pnl.
